cohort: A 24-year-old, ASA II, G1P0 full-term parturient with a pre-existing diagnosis of Arnold-Chiari malformation Type 1 and advanced neurological findings.
finding: The case highlights the need for increased awareness and proper training among healthcare providers for better management of parturients with Arnold-Chiari malformation Type 1, suggesting a multidisciplinary approach.
mod_finding: An elective cesarean section under general anesthesia was chosen as the mode of birth due to the advanced Arnold-Chiari malformation Type 1 with herniation and syrinx, resulting in an uneventful delivery.
